title: House Painting quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Client: Smith Residence, Balmain, NSW. Scope: Full interior repaint (walls and ceilings) and exterior trim repaint. Interior surfaces: Master Bedroom (4m x 3.5m, 2.7m high), Bedroom Two (3m x 3m, 2.7m high), Bedroom Three (3m x 3m, 2.7m high), Living Room (6m x 4m, 2.7m high), Kitchen (3.5m x 3m, 2.7m high). All these rooms include walls and ceilings. Hallway (5m x 1m, 2.7m high): Walls only. Bathroom One (2.5m x 2m, 2.4m high): Walls only. Bathroom Two (2.5m x 2m, 2.4m high): Walls only. All interior walls to receive two coats of premium washable low-sheen acrylic paint. Ceilings to be painted with flat ceiling white. Minor plaster repairs, filling, and sanding included. Exterior Trim: Front Entry Door (1 door) and frame. Six standard windows (1.2m x 1.5m) and frames. House eaves and fascia (approx. 40 linear metres perimeter). All exterior trim to receive two coats of exterior semi-gloss enamel paint. Prep includes scraping loose paint, sanding, and priming bare timber.
workingDetail: Interior paint (walls and ceilings), Exterior paint, Primer and undercoat, Filler, sandpaper, and prep materials
